Minnesota Twins scorecard entries from April 29, 2024

Source: R/twins_scorecard_2024.R
twins_scorecard_2024.Rd

Thirty-five recorded plays involving 12 Twins players in their game against the Chicago White Sox. The play labels and confidence scores come from a saved dAImondInning scorecard result. Player names and comparison labels come from the MLB reference events stored with that result.

Usage

twins_scorecard_2024

Format

A data frame with 35 rows and 10 columns:

game_id

Character. MLB game identifier, "746804".

team

Character. Batting team, "Minnesota Twins".

player

Character. Batter name from the matched MLB reference event.

inning

Character. Inning label retained from the scorecard result.

play

Character. Original canonical play label predicted by the app.

confidence

Numeric. The app's play-classification score, between zero and one; this is not a guarantee that the reading is correct.

needs_review

Logical. TRUE when the app flagged the play, confidence is missing, or the play label differs from its reference label.

game_date

Date. Game date, April 29, 2024.

reference_play

Character. Canonical play label in the cached MLB reference event.

play_matches_reference

Logical. Whether play equals reference_play.

Source

dAImondInning saved result uploads/7617d135a223/result_full.json, extracted October 18, 2026. The corresponding MLB feed is cached as data/mlb_cache/game_746804.json in that app. MLB reference: https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/746804/feed/live.

Details

Blank cells and bad-crop markers are excluded. Each retained cell has one reference event matched by its scorecard row and column. Rows follow the scorecard layout, not chronological play order. All 35 matched batter/inning pairs were checked against the app's cached MLB game feed.

The original play predictions are retained. Thirty-four labels match the reference; Willi Castro's ninth-inning play is classified as flyout while the reference reports lineout. That row has needs_review = TRUE. The seven columns required by calculate_batting_stats() are included, but the flagged row must be reviewed before using that function. Base-out states required for RE24 are not included.

Examples

str(twins_scorecard_2024)
#> 'data.frame':	35 obs. of  10 variables:
#>  $ game_id               : chr  "746804" "746804" "746804" "746804" ...
#>  $ team                  : chr  "Minnesota Twins" "Minnesota Twins" "Minnesota Twins" "Minnesota Twins" ...
#>  $ player                : chr  "Ryan Jeffers" "Ryan Jeffers" "Ryan Jeffers" "Ryan Jeffers" ...
#>  $ inning                : chr  "1" "3" "6" "8" ...
#>  $ play                  : chr  "flyout" "flyout" "walk" "flyout" ...
#>  $ confidence            : num  0.945 0.949 0.948 0.946 0.947 ...
#>  $ needs_review          : logi  FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE ...
#>  $ game_date             : Date, format: "2024-04-29" "2024-04-29" ...
#>  $ reference_play        : chr  "flyout" "flyout" "walk" "flyout" ...
#>  $ play_matches_reference: logi  TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE ...
subset(twins_scorecard_2024, needs_review,
       select = c(player, inning, play, reference_play))
#>          player inning   play reference_play
#> 28 Willi Castro      9 flyout        lineout
